description: KL-21 is the Sub-Regional Transport Office (SRTO) located in Nedumangad, serving the Thiruvananthapuram district. Established in 2006, this office manages vehicle registration, driving licenses, and transport permits specifically for the Nedumangad taluk region.
address: Sub Regional Transport Office, Pazhakutty, Nedumangad, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala
